settings.heading: Free shipping over ₹999
settings.text: Orders above ₹999 ship free across India. Orders below this threshold carry a flat shipping fee, shown at checkout before you pay.

settings.heading: Dispatch & delivery times
settings.text: Orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days. Delivery typically takes 3–7 business days depending on your location, and a tracking link is emailed and texted once your order ships.

settings.heading: Cash on Delivery
settings.text: COD is available on all orders across India, subject to a small COD handling fee shown at checkout.

settings.heading: Where we ship
settings.text: We currently ship across India. For international shipping enquiries, write to support@simplykids.in.
